problem: Previous offline path retained/read/copied two weight layouts and ran full software CRC32 on both files every expert miss, regressing decoding from about 23.32 to 12.29 tokens/s.

measured_causes.crc_microbenchmark: K=2048, N=3072, 1.5MiB codes: full source plus payload software CRC took 1.51-1.67ms, compared with 0.18-0.23ms combined cached file reads (3 samples, 100 iterations each). ARM hardware CRC reduced those checks to 0.47-0.52ms.
measured_causes.uncached_arena_microbenchmark: 100 iterations on actual rpcmem uncached storage: baseline source read+copy 209.515us; prepared read+copy with reused validation 207.037us; prepared direct-to-arena read 142.731us. These are isolated timings, not full-model gains.
measured_causes.whole_model_profile: Removing runtime DSP repack reduced MoE decode DSP time from 251.9 to 188.2us/call (2432 calls in the profiled workload). Deployment-time validation removed the approximately 920ms exposed prefill validation wait seen without a receipt.
measured_causes.remaining_limit: Final profiled expert file handling was 1.45ms/miss versus 1.27ms/miss for the original single model file. Per-artifact I/O/stamp checks still offset some DSP savings; the final TPS claim uses actual full-model measurements, not kernel extrapolation.

changes: Version-2 artifacts store one LUT code image plus unchanged palette/scales/sums. Expert arena code storage returns to K*N/4 bytes, the same as compact-WH baseline.
Prefill and fallback restore compact WH in VTCM with an exact HVX inverse permutation before existing palette expansion. Decode uses LUT codes directly.
Single-layout RPC methods are appended; legacy method ordinals and dual-layout RPC behavior remain available. Rebinding resets prepared-image pointers.

The first unverified load checks full source/payload CRCs. Per-file validation is reused only while model/artifact identities, size and nanosecond mtime/ctime match. ARM CRC instructions are runtime feature-guarded; portable fallback remains.
Verified code bytes are read directly into the uncached shared arena; only small metadata uses CPU scratch. No duplicate code copy or layout expansion in host memory.

validate_qs2_lut performs full verification once on the target and writes an atomic CRC-protected receipt bound to local model/artifact identities. Runtime reuses it across processes only when identities/header match. Missing/stale/malformed receipts use full validation.
Activation precision, palette values, zero-point handling, scales, sums and generated output remain unchanged. Dense LUT mode6 and offline mode7 remain explicit opt-ins.

deployment_validation.cost_accounting: One-time target deployment validation is excluded from per-request inference times. First full validation remains in the inference path if the receipt is absent or stale. Re-run validation after transferring/replacing model or artifacts.

final_benchmark.aggregation: 64 tokens / mean generation wall time; all successful runs included, profiling disabled
final_benchmark.limits: One prompt/model configuration, 6 runs each; small gain, not a guarantee for all routing/cache workloads. Raw temperatures, times, commands and binary hashes are retained.

validation.reader_converter_receipt: 6 Python tests pass, compiling a C++17 reader and native validator: real shapes, independent C layout reference, cold/warm direct reads with guards, source/artifact mutations, missing/corrupt/truncated files, valid/stale/corrupt deployment receipts, CLI conversion/verification.
validation.host_suite: bash test/htp/host/run_host_checks.sh returned 0; host stand-ins do not substitute for device arithmetic tests.
validation.sanitizers: ASan+UBSan exact LUT/WH roundtrip and inverse conversion tests passed for 15 shape/palette cases.
validation.device_moe: M=1/4/65/193, five cache generations (WH -> dual -> WH -> single LUT -> WH), all kernel options and mixed QS2/QS4 fallback are bit-identical to expanded reference; bad palette and overlapping single-layout registration rejected.
validation.builds: Android ARM64 core, DSP v81 and deployment validator build. LUT kernel also compiles for v79 with -Wall -Werror; v79 hardware not tested.
validation.format: clang-format14 applied to changed C/C++ lines; git diff --check passes for edited tracked sources.
validation.scope: No full cross-platform CI matrix, commit or PR performed.

usage.migration: Regenerate old v1 artifacts with the current converter. A receipt is device/file-instance-specific: create it after deploying, not before copying files.

source_build_note: Benchmark binaries contain the final runtime logic. Subsequent edits are clang-format whitespace and a duplicate-offset guard in the standalone deployment validator; reader/validator tests were rerun.
